subject: Starter Briefing — Echelon Health POC: roles, metrics, access
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@echelonhealth.com>, Jay Patel <jay.patel@echelonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T17:12:00Z
Subject: Starter briefing & immediate asks — Echelon POC

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap so we have a single place for owners and immediate next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points (from your team):
- Inconsistent triage of clinical intake notes leading to long manual review queues (~18 hrs/day).
- High cost of QA for extracted fields; downstream tooling requires high precision.
- Need for on-prem/isolated processing for PHI-sensitive flows.

Primary goals for the POC (agreed):
1) Reduce average manual review time by 40% on a sampled workflow.
2) Achieve >= 92% precision on extracted discrete fields in the prompt set.
3) Validate latency and cost targets for a 10k/day inference volume (estimate).

Proposed POC scope (3-week focused sprint):
- Week 0 (prep): data access + account setup, prompt seed delivery, redaction checklist.
- Week 1 (eval): run initial prompt set across 2k annotated samples, create baseline metrics.
- Week 2 (iterate): tuning and targeted prompt/eval updates, deploy a small dedicated instance for throughput checks.
- Deliverables: summary metric dashboard, prompt seed file, runbook for production handoff.

Success metrics (owner ownership in parentheses):
- Precision on field extraction >= 92% (Echelon / Sara)
- Latency P95 under 350ms for single-record inference on dedicated instance (Ben)
- Cost projection per 1k requests (Grace)

Immediate asks (timeline in parentheses):
- Provide a secure S3 location (or equivalent) with a 2k-sample CSV and a separate 200-record validation set (by Mon 2026-12-20) — OWNER: Sara
- Confirm whether Echelon requires a BAA / specific encryption standards for data at rest (ASAP) — OWNER: Jay / Legal
- Grant a read-only service account (RBAC) for Redwood to the dataset (instructions below) — OWNER: Sara

Data & security notes:
- We will only use the samples you provide for POC evaluation; production patterns will be discussed if POC passes.
- We can perform redaction prior to transfer — indicate whether you want Redwood to run a redaction pass or if you will supply already-redacted data.

Attachments: poc_scope_v1.pdf (scope & timeline), prompt_seed_v1.csv (seed prompts / expected labels)

Next meeting: propose Tue 2026-12-21 10:00am PT for kickoff if data + access are available.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Sara Liu <sara@echelonhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jay Patel <jay.patel@echelonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Starter briefing & immediate asks — Echelon POC

Thanks Grace — that recap aligns with our notes. Quick answers:
- We'll provision a secure S3 bucket and share a pre-signed URL for the two datasets by EOD Mon 2026-12-20.
- Legal: we do require a BAA and certain encryption-at-rest rules. I've looped in legal (legal@echelonhealth.com) and Jay is our internal security contact for specifics.
- We will supply a partially redacted set (PHI tokenized) and would like Redwood to run a secondary redaction pass during ingestion to ensure consistency. Please confirm the redaction pipeline and whether it requires special IAM scopes.

Also: a small ask — can you confirm that the prompt seed file will be processed in a private VPC instance (we cannot use shared hosted endpoints for this POC)?

Sara Liu
Head of Product Operations | Echelon Health
sara@echelonhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara@echelonhealth.com>, Jay Patel <jay.patel@echelonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-16T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Starter briefing & immediate asks — Echelon POC (ops plan + access)

Putting down the ops steps and owners from our infra side so we can move fast once we get the sample data.

Operational checklist (Ben / Redwood infra):
- Confirmed: we will run the POC inside a private VPC deployment (Redwood Private) to satisfy your PHI constraints.
- Access needed: a read-only IAM/service account key and temporary STS credentials for the S3 presigned URLs. Do NOT share long-lived keys.
- Onboarding doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCStarter (shared) — includes the ingestion template and redaction spec.
- Temporary endpoints: we will provision a small dedicated pool (1x A100 equivalent) for Week 2 throughput checks. Expected provisioning lead time: 24–48 hours after we receive access.

Owners & ETA: 
- Service account + S3 access: Sara (due 2026-12-20)
- Redaction confirmation: Echelon Legal (due 2026-12-18)
- Prompt seed ingestion: Marissa (run once data is available) — Marissa will produce a baseline eval report within 48 hours of ingestion.

Attachment: access_instructions.txt (contains step-by-step IAM & presigned URL guidance).

Ben Carter
Principal Product Manager, Dedicated Services | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@echelonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Starter briefing & immediate asks — Echelon POC (kickoff confirmation)

Thanks all — final confirmation from our side.

- Kickoff scheduled: Tue 2026-12-21 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).
- We will provision Redwood Private instance once we receive the presigned URL + short-lived STS access. Ben: please queue infrastructure provisioning Monday morning so the dedicated pool is live before Week 2.
- Marissa: please run the prompt_seed_v1.csv ingestion and publish the baseline report to the shared Drive folder within 48 hours of data arrival.
- Legal: once we have the BAA in place we'll exchange the SOW. I've attached the current POC scope (poc_scope_v1.pdf) and the seed prompts (prompt_seed_v1.csv) for your records. Please sign the simple SOW; DocuSign link below.

DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/recipient?token=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54829

If no objections, we'll treat Tue 12/21 as the official POC start for scheduling and resource allocation.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
